description: The Enterprise's final year pushes the crew toward unresolved family histories, alternate realities and choices about Starfleet itself before Q returns to test Picard across past, present and future.

s07e01.description: Lore manipulates Data’s emotions and commands renegade Borg while Picard’s crew tries to restore Data’s judgment and free the drones.

s07e02.description: Picard crash-lands with a mysterious woman while alien diplomats aboard the Enterprise conduct unsettling experiments in human emotions.

s07e03.description: Geordi uses an experimental probe interface to search a hostile environment and becomes convinced his missing mother may still be alive.

s07e04.description: Picard disappears while investigating archaeological thefts, leading Riker into an undercover mission aboard a mercenary vessel.

s07e05.description: Picard and Riker uncover a Vulcan weapon hidden among ancient artifacts and must outmaneuver the mercenaries assembling it.

s07e06.description: Data’s bizarre dreams begin reflecting a real parasitic threat aboard the Enterprise while Picard faces an uncomfortable diplomatic banquet.

s07e07.description: Lwaxana collapses under the weight of a repressed family memory, forcing Troi into her mother’s mind to uncover the buried loss.

s07e08.description: Picard and Crusher escape captivity linked by neural implants that expose their thoughts and force long-avoided feelings into the open.

s07e09.description: Scientists warn that warp travel is damaging subspace, but the Enterprise crew resists the claim until one researcher takes drastic action.

s07e10.description: Data meets a woman claiming to be his creator’s former wife and surrogate mother, then discovers a secret about her own identity.

s07e11.description: Worf begins shifting through alternate realities where relationships, careers and even the Enterprise’s history have taken different paths.

s07e12.description: Riker’s former captain returns to recover a lost Starfleet vessel, forcing Riker to confront an illegal cloaking experiment and his own past.

s07e13.description: Worf’s foster brother secretly rescues villagers from a doomed planet, violating the Prime Directive and bringing them aboard the Enterprise.

s07e14.description: Crusher attends her grandmother’s funeral and becomes entangled with a mysterious lover connected to generations of women in her family.

s07e15.description: Junior officers compete for promotion while unknowingly becoming involved in a dangerous classified mission near Cardassian space.

s07e16.description: An amnesiac Data is stranded among a preindustrial community while Troi works toward qualification as a bridge command officer.

s07e17.description: An alien archive transforms the Enterprise into a ritual landscape and takes over Data with multiple personalities from a vanished civilization.

s07e18.description: Troi investigates a crewman’s suicide and becomes trapped in psychic echoes of a decades-old tragedy inside the Enterprise.

s07e19.description: A medical treatment triggers dormant genetic traits across the crew, transforming the Enterprise into a ship of increasingly primitive lifeforms.

s07e20.description: Federation colonists are ordered to leave a world transferred to Cardassian control while Wesley questions Starfleet and his own future.

s07e21.description: Worf struggles to interest Alexander in Klingon heritage until a mysterious warrior arrives with an unusually personal investment in the boy.

s07e22.description: Bok threatens the son Picard never knew he had, forcing the captain to confront a possible family connection and an old Ferengi vendetta.

s07e23.description: The Enterprise itself appears to become intelligent, using holodeck characters and ship systems to carry out an unexplained reproductive process.

s07e24.description: Ro returns from advanced training and infiltrates the Maquis, but growing sympathy for the rebels places her loyalty to Picard in conflict.

s07e25-26.description: Q sends Picard jumping between three periods of his life as an expanding spatial anomaly threatens humanity’s existence across time.
